reserve_attestation_refused.why: PUT /api/simulation/solver_config refuses a commercial reserve_no_backup_storages attestation (SCU06 K8b) naming a DC-03 backup string or spare or a ride-through storage, or made where the project's backup setting or island sidecar cannot be read. The assistant names the storage and says a storage holding backup energy keeps its backup floor; it may only attest storage with no backup role, in a saved project.
